meta.name: AirSuspension
meta.description: Air suspension module with user-adjustable height. Supports selecting a target height from the fixed capability set and querying actual height, adjustment progress, and failure feedback.

target_height.description: Height selected for the current or most recently started adjustment.

actual_height.description: Current achieved suspension height. It changes to target_height when an adjustment completes.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the height-adjustment process.

phase.description: Current phase of the height-adjustment process.

remaining_minutes.description: Whole simulated minutes remaining in the current adjustment.

started_at_minute.description: Simulation elapsed-minute timestamp from which progress for the current adjustment is measured.

progress_minutes.description: Whole simulated minutes completed in the current or most recently completed adjustment.

failure_feedback.description: Failure feedback for the adjustment mechanism. The value is none when no deterministic mechanism failure has been reported.

get_target_height.description: Return the selected target suspension height without changing state.

target_height.description: Selected target height: low, normal, or high.

get_actual_height.description: Return the currently achieved suspension height without changing state.

actual_height.description: Current achieved height: low, normal, or high.

get_status.description: Return the lifecycle status of the height-adjustment process.

status.description: Adjustment status: idle, running, paused, or completed.

get_phase.description: Return the current phase of the height-adjustment process.

phase.description: Current phase: idle, adjusting, or completed.

get_remaining_minutes.description: Return the whole simulated minutes remaining in the current adjustment.

get_started_at_minute.description: Return the simulation elapsed-minute timestamp used as the origin of the current adjustment.

started_at_minute.description: Simulation elapsed-minute timestamp for the adjustment origin.

get_progress_minutes.description: Return the whole simulated minutes completed in the current or most recently completed adjustment.

get_failure_feedback.description: Return current adjustment failure feedback. This deterministic model returns none unless a modeled mechanism failure is present.

select_height.description: Start a one-minute adjustment toward low, normal, or high suspension height. The action is allowed only while the previous process is idle or completed. Starting sets progress to zero and actual_height remains unchanged until completion. Invalid targets or a failed status precondition leave all state unchanged.

errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Height must be low, normal, or high.
errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: A new suspension-height adjustment cannot start while another adjustment is running or paused.

after_action.description: After a successful action transitions the height-adjustment process into running, set started_at_minute to the current simulation elapsed minute minus progress_minutes. Actions that do not transition the process into running leave process timing state unchanged.

effect_properties.name: status
effect_properties.description: Indicates whether the process has transitioned into the running state.

effect_properties.name: started_at_minute
effect_properties.description: Stores the elapsed-minute origin used to calculate adjustment progress.

effect_properties.name: progress_minutes
effect_properties.description: Offsets the timing origin so any retained process progress is preserved.

tick.description: While an adjustment is running, advance its progress using the declared one-minute adjusting phase. At the exact completion boundary, set actual_height to target_height, set remaining_minutes to zero, and mark the phase and status completed. Idle, paused, and completed adjustments do not advance.

effect_properties.name: target_height
effect_properties.description: Provides the height assigned to actual_height when adjustment completes.

effect_properties.name: actual_height
effect_properties.description: Stores the currently achieved suspension height.

effect_properties.name: status
effect_properties.description: Determines whether the adjustment advances and records completion.

effect_properties.name: phase
effect_properties.description: Records the active adjusting phase or completed phase.

effect_properties.name: started_at_minute
effect_properties.description: Provides the elapsed-minute origin for deterministic progress.
